title: Team uniform signature
slide_intent: Make staff identification clear at conversational distance so the person serving food visibly belongs to the brand.
strategic_value: The small bright wordmark can make Sweetgreen’s uniform recognizable without competing with the worker.
demonstration: A cropped staff portrait pairs a green shirt with a small yellow-green wordmark and a plain black apron.
practical_value: Assess signature size and contrast relative to uniform layers.

content_islands.name: Shirt signature
content_islands.spec: Place the small wordmark at the center of the green chest.

content_islands.name: Apron and portrait
content_islands.spec: Keep the black apron and close crop as the physical context.

reference_purposes.Application: The wordmark is applied to a staff shirt worn beneath an apron.
